items.title: Rashied Ali and Henry Grimes interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, January 30, 2009
items.q: for instance, a musician like Willis Jackson, you could play with him and get that amount of money

ctx.x: Yeah. It was the most money I ever made. And I mean a lot of it was left over and whenever they kept the money, but I mean, but it was, for instance, a musician like Willis Jackson, you could play with him and get that amount of money, so it was pretty cool.
And, you know anybody like that, the pay is cool.
